about: What each bundled component's licence lets SecuRAX do once it is sold (doc 110). Read by ./securax venture guards (guard licence-terms) and held current by governance/tests/test_licences.py: every image in local/compose must be listed. 'terms' is what to keep doing; 'sell' is ok (no condition), conditions (allowed, with the condition) or ask (needs the owner's written licence first). A summary from each project's own licence page, checked 2026-10-22; the licence text itself decides.

components.licence: MIT (the enterprise/ folder is under a separate commercial licence)
components.terms: use only the MIT features; enterprise features need BerriAI's licence

components.licence: Open WebUI License (BSD-3 with a branding clause, from v0.6.6)
components.terms: keep the Open WebUI name and logo visible in any deployment serving more than 50 users in 30 days, unless you hold their enterprise licence

components.licence: Sustainable Use License (fair-code, not open source)
components.terms: internal business use and paid consulting are allowed; hosting n8n for paying customers, or selling a product whose value comes mainly from n8n, needs n8n's commercial or Embed licence
unmodified use is fine; if you modify it and offer it over a network, publish the modified source
changes to its own files stay MPL and are published
as Grafana; and never call it Bitwarden: it is an independent project, and the name is another firm's mark

components.licence: MIT for the Team Edition binary (the source is AGPL-3.0 and Apache-2.0)
components.terms: ship the unmodified binary; enterprise features need Mattermost's licence

components.licence: AGPL-3.0 (the image is a community build; each model's weights carry their own use licence)
components.terms: optional, off by default; check the chosen model's licence before any paid use

models.terms: never a default; a person who pins one checks its licence
follow Meta's acceptable use policy and show 'Built with Llama'
